title: Headless scene-state JUnit tests for the main scenes, reading the Tool base and calling route handlers in-process (TOOL-28 part 2)
description:
Split from TOOL-28, which built the golden fingerprints and the snapshot main. Build:
1. A test harness: install the suite platform with GlStandIn, AutomationRuntime.serveHttp=false and the render thread set to the test thread so runOnMainThread runs inline; show scenes and paint frames; call the State, words, tools, control, key and click handlers in-process (no HTTP). Check that every scene's initGL tolerates GlStandIn.
2. Reset shared static state per test class (MenuBox.menuVisible/menuItems, Terminal.current, Scene.instance, AutomationRuntime.canvas, the audio logs, Clock, IxdarWindow.canvasId), or fork per class, so no test depends on an earlier one.
3. One test per main scene: menu, knot editor, mesh viewer, the ring scene with each tool, trade; read the Tool base (lastRow, lastError, history, draft, preview, items, hovered), Scene.dataset and Scene.panes directly, and drive tools through the general tool routes (TOOL-36/38).
definition-of-done:
1. The harness runs any scene headlessly in-process.
2. Every main scene has a state test; the ring scene covers each tool.
3. Tests pass in any order (run once shuffled).
4. Default mvn test time increase reported.
testing-plan: 1. mvn test, and once with test order shuffled.
